searchDocs.title: Button Example​
searchDocs.content: Here, we set up a basic UI in Roblox Studio.  A TextButton and TextBox parented to a ScreenGui for the UIA LocalScript (also parented to the ScreenGui) to handle the button behavior    Under the LocalScript, we'll write a code that sends the text from TextBox to ScagJPT when TextButton is pressed.\n We can use the ScagRPC.Say() function.  -- LocalScript local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local ScagRPC = require(ReplicatedStorage.ScagRPC) local TextBox = script.Parent.TextBox local Send = script.Parent.TextButton Send.Activated:Connect(function() local text = TextBox.Text ScagRPC.Say(text) end)   And we're done!  When you click the button, ScagJPT will say whatever text is in the TextBox.

searchDocs.title: Server Code​
searchDocs.content: -- Script local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local RemoteEvent: RemoteEvent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.MyEvent function OnPlayerAdded(player: Player) RemoteEvent:FireAllClients(player) end game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(OnPlayerAdded)

searchDocs.title: Client Code​
searchDocs.content: -- LocalScript local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage") local ScagRPC = require(ReplicatedStorage.ScagRPC) local RemoteEvent: RemoteEvent = ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.MyEvent function OnEventFired(player: Player) ScagRPC.Say("oh, hey! it's " .. player.DisplayName .. "!") end RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(OnEventFired)

searchDocs.title: Testing in Roblox Studio​
searchDocs.content: When testing on Roblox Studio, make sure:  ScagJPT is running before you open StudioThe "Read Studio logs instead" setting is enabled in ScagJPT's settings. This lets it read your Roblox Studio logs, instead of your Roblox Player. You can find this setting in the "Developer" tab.    warning When you want to use ScagRPC in a published game, don't forget to disable the "Read Studio logs instead" setting!

searchDocs.title: Setting up ScagRPC​
searchDocs.content: When you download ScagRPC from the Roblox Marketplace, you get a ModuleScript that other scripts can require from. You can place this ModuleScript anywhere, but it's recommended to be under ReplicatedStorage.

searchDocs.title: Commands​
searchDocs.content: </> type Commands = "say" | "fling" | "say_preset" The list of commands that can be sent to ScagJPT.

searchDocs.title: Say​
searchDocs.content: </> ScagRPC.Say(text: string) → () Creates a speech bubble over Scag's head with the given text. You can customize the text using the BBCode formatting system. [b]bold[/b] for bold text [i]italic[/i] for italic text [u]underline[/u] for underlined text [color=red]red text[/color] for colored text [size=20]large text[/size] for larger text ScagRPC.Say("hello!!") task.wait(2) ScagRPC.Say("i am scag!") task.wait(1) ScagRPC.Say("this is [b]SOOOO[/b] cool!")

searchDocs.title: Fling​
searchDocs.content: </> ScagRPC.Fling(velocity: Vector2? ) → () Flings Scag with a given force, or randomly if no force is provided. -- Fling in a specific direction ScagRPC.Fling(Vector2.new(10, 10)) -- Fling in a random direction ScagRPC.Commands.Fling()

searchDocs.title: Say​
searchDocs.content: </> Presets.Say: {[string]: string} A dictionary of preset keys for use with the Say RPC.
